faqs.q: What kind of role are you looking for?
faqs.a: A business tools developer role in an industrial environment: internal apps for tracking, traceability or automated quality checks, working closely with operational teams.

faqs.q: What does your field experience bring to a project?
faqs.a: I know the constraints of the people who will use the tool: shop-floor data entry, compliance documents, traceability requirements. I ask the right questions before writing the first line of code.

faqs.q: What technologies do you specialize in?
faqs.a: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker and Git, with AI as an everyday accelerator.

aboutPage.heroIntro: Quality inspector in an industrial setting and fullstack web developer, I build business tools that make life easier for shop-floor teams: tracking, traceability, document checks.
aboutPage.whoAmIPara1: Day to day, I check the traceability and compliance of parts and the documents that come with them. Alongside that, I build web applications, including a non-profit management platform that is now in production.
aboutPage.whoAmIPara2: My background is unconventional, and that is a strength. For eleven years in hotels and restaurants, notably as assistant manager, I worked in close coordination with kitchen and dining room teams: rigour, a sense of service, quick reactions to the unexpected. After retraining in web development, I joined a start-up to handle application maintenance on a car rental platform (Node.js, MongoDB, Docker), in an agile setup. Now a quality inspector in industry, I bring that dual perspective, field and technical, to building practical tools.
aboutPage.whoAmIPara3: AI is part of how I work: learning faster, debugging, documenting, automating repetitive tasks. I build tools for my own needs first, and that is what makes me progress fastest.
aboutPage.whatIBringBody: I speak two languages: the shop floor's and the code's. I know what an inspector expects from a tool (reliability, speed, no double entry), and I know how to build it. That dual perspective makes it easier for operational teams and the IT team to work together.

philosophies.quote: Right model, right task. Claude for nuanced reasoning, Gemini for fast research, ChatGPT for code exploration.
AI accelerates, humans validate. I don't publish generated content without critical review. AI is a co-pilot, not autopilot.
Build to understand. QuizFlip and OpenClaw aren't showcase projects — they're tools I actually use.

aboutPage.skillsSubtitle: Technologies I use daily across my projects
aboutPage.aiWorkflowIntro: AI has been part of my workflow since 2023 — not as a replacement tool, but as an accelerator. I choose the right model for the task, and I know when not to use it.

aiUsages.title: Development
aiUsages.body: Component generation, debugging, code review and documentation. AI reduces lookup time on known syntax and speeds up exploration of unfamiliar patterns.

aiUsages.title: Learning
aiUsages.body: Topic-based flashcard generation via QuizFlip + Gemini. Technical documentation summaries. Keeping up with emerging tools — OpenClaw being a recent example.

aiUsages.title: Writing & documentation
aiUsages.body: Technical documentation, READMEs, proofreading and rewording the copy on my sites. The human validates relevance, AI speeds up production.

aiUsages.title: Automation
aiUsages.body: Personal assistant via OpenClaw + Telegram, with multi-model fallback. Repetitive tasks, reminders, processing pipelines — all triggered from my phone.

projectDetailPage.overviewBody1: This project represents a comprehensive solution built with modern technologies and best practices. Every aspect was carefully considered to ensure scalability, maintainability, and exceptional user experience.
projectDetailPage.overviewBody2Suffix: The implementation focuses on clean architecture, type safety, and performance optimization. Special attention was given to the developer experience and long-term maintainability of the codebase.
projectDetailPage.technicalBody1: The project leverages a modern stack including Next.js 14 with App Router, TypeScript for type safety, and Tailwind CSS for styling. The database layer uses Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL for reliable data persistence.
projectDetailPage.technicalBody2: Docker containerization ensures consistent deployments across environments, while CI/CD pipelines automate testing and deployment workflows.
